name: Bacon Wrapped Halibut with Lemony Brussels Sprout Salad
instructions: Wash, dry, and juice lemon into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Pat halibut dry with paper towels, cut into portions (if necessary), and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Season with spices, then wrap 2 slices of bacon around each portion; drizzle with oil.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until the fish is almost cooked through, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and thinly slice Brussels sprouts crosswise; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Finely grate Parmesan and add to the bowl.
Add almonds to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
When the fish is almost cooked through, change oven setting to broil on high, and continue to cook until the bacon is crisp and fish is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide halibut and Brussels sprout salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
